verdict.rationale: Companies House's own service page says it lets you 'file certain documents online instead of posting a paper form', which shows a postal paper-form rail exists alongside online filing. Nothing in the pack shows that rail published with specifics a founder could act on. missing for 10: published postal addresses, named paper form identifiers, fax or phone numbers, which tasks can be completed on paper, and guidance for when the online service is unavailable.
